description: The bootcamp Demo 2 evaluation script (AI-Course-Development/AI-Deep-Learning-Program/student-workspace/evaluations/evaluate_skill_output.py) advertised a --report-md flag in its README but had no Report.to_markdown() method, so any run with --report-md crashed with AttributeError after writing the JSON. It would have crashed live at the lectern during the Demo Slide (Python Evaluation with LLM Judge).
correction: Added Report.to_markdown() producing a markdown findings table. Verified --report-md now writes evaluations/trend-identification-report.md; regression-checked the baseline JSON run (4/6, 66.7%) is unchanged.
systemic_fix: Verify every advertised CLI flag end-to-end before committing a demo script. A flag documented in the README is a shipped contract, not an aspiration.
